title: Evaluate automatic retry after a retained Human intake's persistence deadline
outcome: After sync, decide whether one automatic retry is worthwhile and design it around exact queue and runtime ownership while preserving manual Resume.
acceptance: The post-sync design resolves automatic owner revocation and idle exit (#2), terminal diagnostics after head cancellation (#6), and injected-time reset coverage (#7) before any implementation is admitted.
disposal_reason: Fable2 #3391–3392 and Greg 588693a8 #2087 supersede #3390. Automatic recovery remains the parent outcome and adopts Kimi's one-shot fence design after the manual interim lands. This planning duplicate was filed under the earlier instruction.
